images.alt: A Macintosh Quadra 800 mini-tower seen from the front-left: beige case, CD-ROM and floppy drive bays at the top, the Apple logo and 'Macintosh Quadra 800' badge low on the front
images.caption: The Macintosh Quadra 800 (1993) — Apple's 33 MHz 68040 mini-tower, the machine this station emulates. A/UX 3.0.1 was the release that added support for it.

images.alt: A Macintosh Quadra 800 tower photographed against white, showing the drive bays and the front panel with its power light and vents
images.caption: Quadra 800 from the front. Under the beige is a 68040 with its PMMU and FPU — both of which A/UX requires; A/UX never ran on the FPU-less LC or Performa lines.

images.commonsFile: File:Quadra 840AV & Macintosh 16-inch Color Display & AppleDesign Powered Speakers & Apple Extended Keyboard II & Apple Desktop Bus Mouse II.jpg
images.alt: A complete Macintosh desk: a Quadra 840AV mini-tower next to a 16-inch Apple colour display, AppleDesign powered speakers, an Apple Extended Keyboard II and an ADB Mouse II
images.caption: The same tower chassis one step up — a Quadra 840AV — with the 16-inch Apple display, Extended Keyboard II and ADB Mouse II. That ADB mouse is the pointer this station drives, and why the cursor here is a tracked, relative one.

images.alt: The logic board of a Macintosh Quadra 840AV: the large 68040 processor under a heatsink, RAM SIMM sockets, three NuBus slots along one edge and the SCSI, ADB and serial ports
images.caption: Inside the tower: a Quadra logic board with the 68040, RAM SIMMs, NuBus slots and the on-board SCSI. A/UX's autoconfig walked exactly this hardware at first boot and rebuilt its kernel to match.

images.alt: One end of a long shelf of grey Apple A/UX 3.0 manuals: Command Reference, User Interface, System Administrator's Reference, Network System Administration and Local System Administration, each with the Apple logo on the spine
images.caption: The A/UX 3.0 documentation set — a whole shelf of it. This was a commercial Unix sold to government and universities, and it came with the paperwork of one.
